subject: Harry Kane
title: Kane: a Ballon d'Or, a crossbar and a museum

lines.vo: A Ballon d'Or, a crossbar, and a plan for a museum.
lines.footage: Kane in a Bayern shirt, close-up, Allianz Arena

lines.vo: Kane won the Ballon d'Or in October, and he has been busy since.
lines.footage: Harry Kane Ballon d'Or ceremony London Palladium 2026, stage shot

lines.vo: He beat Mbappé by twenty-eight points, with forty first-place votes to twenty-three.
lines.footage: Ballon d'Or 2026 results graphic, Kane and Mbappé in the crowd

lines.vo: Then he passed Shilton's England caps record. A plaque from Shilton, a shirt from Prince William. Busy shelf.
lines.footage: Kane 126th cap at Wembley vs Croatia, plaque presentation

lines.vo: Now he wants the Ballon d'Or in Bayern's museum. Modesty has left the building.
lines.footage: Kane holding the Ballon d'Or in a Bayern setting, clean club footage

lines.vo: Before Der Klassiker he showed off the trophy. Then his penalty hit the crossbar. Dortmund drew 2-2. The crossbar sends thanks.
lines.footage: Bayern vs Dortmund 2-2, Kane penalty hits the bar, clean match highlights

inserts.story: A caricature of Kane carries a golden ball trophy to a tall museum glass case. Gag: the case is too small, so he squeezes the trophy in and then himself. Twist: a cartoon guard taps the glass and Kane gives a tiny wave from inside.
A caricature of Kane lines up a penalty. Gag: the ball clangs off the crossbar with a huge ringing bell sound and the bar shakes. Twist: the ball rebounds into his hands and he sighs.

facts_used: Ballon d'Or 2026 (26 Oct): Kane 1,055, Mbappé 1,027; 40 first-place votes to 23 - https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50330001/2026-ballon-dor-results-men-full-women-votes-kane-mbappe
England caps: 126th cap v Croatia, passed Shilton's 125; Shilton plaque; Prince William shirt - https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50451241/harry-kane-england-caps-record-126-croatia

Showed the trophy before Bayern vs Dortmund; 57th-minute penalty hit the crossbar; Dortmund drew 2-2 - https://www.skysports.com/football/bayern-vs-dortmund/report/563377
L'Equipe: fourth-closest vote in the award's 70-year history - https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50330001/2026-ballon-dor-results-men-full-women-votes-kane-mbappe (medium confidence)
notes: Non-comic, so no inserts. The acupuncture and injury stories are excluded (health). The caps milestone and the Shilton plaque are factual. 'Modesty has left the building' is opinion on the museum ask (SportBILD report). The crossbar line is a sporting fact, not a personal attack. The 57th-minute detail is from the Sky Sports report in facts_used. The 'fourth-closest vote' claim is from L'Equipe via ESPN, medium confidence, so it is left out of the script.
